words.occurrenceRole: Introduces the person identified by the following actions.

ayahs.translation: who amasses wealth and keeps counting it,
ayahs.naturalMeaning: The description turns to the person who gathers wealth and obsessively counts it.

words.occurrenceRole: Introduces the person's false belief about his wealth.
Introduces the content of the person's mistaken belief.

Expresses the false belief that wealth makes its owner immortal.

ayahs.translation: thinking that his wealth will make him immortal.
ayahs.naturalMeaning: He wrongly imagines that possessions can preserve him forever.

words.occurrenceRole: Rejects the illusion that wealth can make a person immortal.

parts.label: No indeed

words.occurrenceRole: Names the crushing Fire into which the person will be cast.

parts.label: Crusher
parts.meaning: the noun describing something that crushes

ayahs.translation: No indeed! He will certainly be cast into the Crusher.
ayahs.naturalMeaning: That illusion is rejected: he will be thrown into the crushing Fire.

words.occurrenceRole: Opens the question asking the listener to recognize the Crusher.

parts.label: and
parts.meaning: a connector joining the next question

words.occurrenceRole: Addresses the listener in the question about the Crusher.

Names the crushing Fire into which the person will be cast.

parts.label: Crusher
parts.meaning: the noun describing something that crushes

ayahs.translation: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?
ayahs.naturalMeaning: The question magnifies the reality of the Crusher beyond ordinary imagination.

words.occurrenceRole: Identifies the Crusher as Fire.
Attributes the Fire to Allah.
Describes Allah's Fire as kindled.

ayahs.naturalMeaning: The Crusher is the fully ignited Fire belonging to Allah.

words.occurrenceRole: Connects the Fire to the way it reaches the hearts.

parts.label: over
parts.meaning: a preposition marking position or direction

words.occurrenceRole: Names the hearts reached by the Fire.

ayahs.naturalMeaning: Its reach is described as penetrating to the deepest inner hearts.

words.occurrenceRole: Confirms the reality of the Fire described before.

parts.label: it
parts.meaning: an attached pronoun referring to the feminine Fire

words.occurrenceRole: Shows the Fire closed over those condemned.

ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is closed over them,
ayahs.naturalMeaning: The Fire is sealed over those condemned within it.

words.occurrenceRole: Places the casting inside the Crusher.

parts.label: in
parts.meaning: a preposition marking location or containment

words.occurrenceRole: Names the extended columns in the closing image.

ayahs.naturalMeaning: The final image is one of an enclosure sealed by long, extended columns.
